findings.body: This gate was renamed to `AIReview`, but the repo's actual label is still `Ready` — `gh label list` shows no `AIReview` label exists. After merge, applying `Ready` no longer matches `"aireview"`, so the `scope` job always exits with an empty matrix and the whole self-review dogfood silently stops firing until someone creates the new label by hand. Rename the existing `Ready` label to `AIReview` when this lands (a rename keeps it applied to open PRs), or create `AIReview` and retire `Ready` in the same change.

This comment now cites `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md § "Recipe: run once when labelled \`AIReview\`…"`, but that section (`docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md:64`) is still titled *…labelled `ready`…* and its `empty_reason` example is still `no-ready-label` (`docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md:181,190`). `AGENTS.md:315` also still describes the dogfood as "label-gated on `ready`". Update those three spots so the docs keep tracking the reference implementation.

summary:
## Verdict

The complexity-labeling dogfood itself is correctly wired, but the PR also renames the self-review gate label (`ready` → `AIReview`) without renaming the actual repo label — as it stands, merging this silently disables the self-review dogfood until a label is created manually.

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | ⚠️ warning | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:122` | No `AIReview` label exists on the repo (gate label is still `Ready`) — the dogfood can never fire after merge |
| 2 | ℹ️ info | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:56` | Comment cites a TRIGGER_MODES.md section title that still says `ready`; `AGENTS.md:315` also stale |

## Verified as correct

- **Complexity labeling (the stated purpose) checks out end-to-end:** `complexity-labels-enabled` / `complexity-label-prefix` exist in `action.yml:118-125` and are wired to `AIPRR_COMPLEXITY_LABELS_ENABLED` / `AIPRR_COMPLEXITY_LABEL_PREFIX` (`action.yml:325-326`). `gh_apply_label` (`scripts/reviewer.py:731`) creates a missing label on the 422 fallback, and `gh_remove_labels_by_prefix` replaces stale `complexity:*` labels on re-review — so the repo's existing `complexity:low/medium/high` labels will be reused, and the test-plan expectation "prior labels replaced" matches the code at `scripts/reviewer.py:6664-6682`.
- **The agent-runner no-op claim is accurate:** `build_agent_runner_noop_warning` (`scripts/reviewer.py:5241`) logs exactly the warning described in the PR for `claude-code`/`cursor` legs.
- **Case handling is consistent:** the scope job lowercases both the label list and the event label, and the action's defense-in-depth `label-gate: AIReview` matches case-insensitively via `gh_pr_has_label` (`scripts/reviewer.py:773`).
- **`empty_reason` rename is internally consistent:** producer (line 136) and the gate consumer (line 382) were both updated.
